description.value:
You've bluffed your way through more situations than you'd like to admit. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When making an ability check with a skill or tool to which your proficiency bonus would not normally apply, you may first attempt a DC 15 Charisma (Deception) check; success lets you add your proficiency bonus to the original check after all. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses after a short or long rest.
